method: Rung 3, count of the congress's own final programme, ZERO searches. Language: English (ICC11 is run by the Ceramic Society of Japan in English; its programme and site are English, so no Japanese-language count page was needed - the Japanese society site ceramic.or.jp hosts the English congress pages). Route: the phase-1 host page led to https://www.ceramic.or.jp/icc11/ -> /program/ -> icc11_program.pdf (120 pp) and the two poster layout PDFs. ID scheme: DD-ROOM-Sx-session-nn, where ROOM is a 3-digit or 3-letter hall for orals and 'P' for posters. Orals: python regex r'\((\d{2}-(?:\d{3}|[A-Z]{3})-S\d+-\d+-\d{2}[A-Z]?)\)' over the text; for each ID take the text up to the next ID and mark it invited if it contains '(Invited)', '(Keynote)' or '(Plenary)' -> 505 contributed / 368 invited (identical on -layout and -raw). Posters: grep -oE '\b[0-9]{2}-P-S[0-9]+-[0-9]+-[0-9]{2}[A-Z]?\b' | sort -u | wc -l = 552 (programme, both modes; layouts, both modes). EXCLUDED: PLENARY 1-4, 368 invited/keynote orals, and 3 contributed orals cancelled per the programme-updates list on https://www.ceramic.or.jp/icc11/program/. Contributed = 502 + 552 = 1,054 - inside the ~900-1,499 BORDERLINE band. Decisive-row spot check done (three-artefact agreement on posters; two-mode agreement on orals). Rung 9 not run (counted figure exists). NOTE for de-duplication: ICC is the International Ceramic Federation's congress; it is distinct from the American Ceramic Society's own annual meetings (MS&T, ICACC) - check those are not also on the sheet as this row.
